name: Nariño (Nariño, Colombia)
description: Green field with a yellow triangle from the upper hoist corner widening to the lower fly.
history: Municipal flag of Nariño, a municipality in the department of Nariño, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.

features.role: triangle from the upper hoist corner to the lower fly
